mission: Bind each admitted single-artifact SKILL.md observation to the exact ordinary blob committed at the already-observed discovery HEAD before repository_skill authority can be emitted.
appliedContract: The existing try_forever_skill_head_blob_observation and try_forever_skill_head_content_binding organs are composed into the sole provenance owner.
One bounded raw-HEAD blob observation is performed for the bounded candidate set before per-file authority work when an authority HEAD is available.
The owner compares content.git_blob_identity from the existing single-artifact observe_skill_content call; SKILL.md is not reopened to compute Git object identity.
Unavailable HEAD blob authority fails the repository-skill set closed before per-file content authority work.
Mismatch or unavailable exact content binding rejects the candidate before SkillRecord append.
Existing tracked-set, root, file-identity, content-custody, snapshot, expected-head, and final-emission custody gates remain in place.
No phone/P0 surface or duplicate provenance owner was introduced.
